verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a static bundle of markdown agent-skill files, installed into a repo or as a plugin. It runs no service and emits no events, so registrable outbound HTTP callbacks are a category error for this kind of product. The evidence's use of 'subscribe' means receiving bundle updates (a read-only, always-current plugin), not webhooks, and nothing shows the product ships webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
